description: The nine debts (rin). Detected when the planet sits in a placement house together with a listed enemy planet. Remedy is a collective family remedy.

rows.cause: A wrong done by elders, for example a family priest dismissed or childlessness caused by family quarrels.
rows.symptoms: Damage to Jupiter-type things: a nearby temple or a peepal tree harmed.
rows.remedy: Every blood relative contributes one rupee and the sum is given at a temple on one day; also honour a peepal tree or shrine within 16 paces of the house exit on the left.

rows.cause: Disrespect of faith and old rituals.
rows.symptoms: A buried fire-place in the house or light shafts in the roof.
rows.remedy: A yajna (fire ritual) funded by equal, joint shares of all blood relatives.
rows.note: Enemy column on the page reads 'Venus or Sun Rahu-Ketu'; taken as Venus, Rahu, Ketu. Ambiguous.

rows.cause: Neglecting a mother who was ill or mistreated, or sending her away from the house.
rows.symptoms: Dirty material dumped near the roof light inlet, or a neighbouring well, river or pond left unrespected.
rows.remedy: Each blood relative gives an equal share of silver, all thrown into flowing water on the same day.

rows.cause: Ending a pregnancy or hurting a woman through temptation.
rows.symptoms: Toothed animals reared in the house, especially cows, and a long-running family grudge.
rows.remedy: Feed good food to 100 healthy cows in one day at the joint, equal cost of the whole family.

rows.cause: Betraying friends or relatives, poisoning or burning, or destroying a buffalo or a house.
rows.symptoms: Aversion to meeting relatives and to family celebrations such as children's birthdays.
rows.remedy: Give part of a job free of charge to a Saturn-type craftsman (builder, artisan, experienced hakim), funded by one rupee from each family member.
rows.note: Table row checked on the page image (placement 1 and 8, enemies Mercury and Ketu). The remedy on p.140 sits directly under the Mars symptom block and above the Mercury block, so the attribution to Mars is certain.

rows.cause: Cheating by word, wrongs done to a daughter or sister, selling or trading children.
rows.symptoms: Selling a child or trading in misguided children.
rows.remedy: Collect one yellow shell (cowrie) from each blood relative, burn them to ash and flow the ash into a river on one day.

rows.cause: Taking a life, or taking a house or land by deceit or without payment.
rows.symptoms: A south-facing house, or a house built on land taken from a childless person or on levelled routes and wells.
rows.remedy: Feed 100 fish in one day, or feed 100 labourers, at the joint equal cost of the whole family.

rows.cause: Betraying associates or in-laws so that other families are ruined.
rows.symptoms: A sewer or abandoned cremation ground or grain-roasting shop below the exit threshold or along the south wall.
rows.remedy: Each blood relative contributes one coconut and all are floated in a river on one day.

rows.cause: Ill intent or foul play towards a dog or beggar, secretly ruining another family or having dogs killed without cause.
rows.symptoms: Harm to dogs or to things of Ketu, or destruction of the family.
rows.remedy: Feed good food to 100 dogs at the joint equal cost of the family, and seek the blessing of a widow living in the house on the left at the entrance.
rows.note: Enemy column ends 'Moon,' with a trailing comma; list may be incomplete. Ambiguous.

first_degree_father.description: Planet in H9 together with Mercury in the listed house indicates first-degree debt to father (Mercury at the root).
first_degree_father.note: Table (p.136, image checked) is headed 'planet in H9 / Mercury position (when Mercury is posited at the root)'. p.137 adds that in both degrees the house 2, 5, 9 or 12 must be in a debilitated condition, otherwise there is no debt to father; we do not test that extra condition, so findings stay flagged. The second-degree table is now transcribed in second_degree_father.

general_indicator.description: Malefic planets (Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) in houses 2, 5, 9 or 12 hint at father's debt.
general_indicator.note: p.132 bold line: malefic planets in H2, 5, 9, 12 indicate father's debt. p.137 narrows this to debilitated houses. Used only as a soft indicator.

scope_note.text: Debt to father is judged from the natal chart only, not the annual chart.

cite.section: Debt to father only from natal chart

second_degree_father.description: Second degree debt to father (p.136, right half): an enemy planet sits at the root of the concerned planet. Transcribed from the page image, not yet used by detectRin because the reading of 'outside H.No.' is not clear.

rows.enemy_condition: Saturn in H2 as evil, or Venus in H5, or Mercury in H9, or Rahu in H12, or Mercury/Venus/Saturn as evil in H3 and H6 (printed in a scrambled block)
